title: a Page owner announces something, with a time on it

criteria.text: Only a Page's managing role can announce or edit; anyone else sees no control and a direct write is refused; an edit happens in place and stays the same announcement
criteria.note: `requireManagingRole` via `managingRoleForKind` in `group.post_create` and `group.post_edit`; edit is an `update` on the same row id; `page_posts` has no client write policy [V actions/group/post.ts]. Built by #115 (T164) and #183 (T166); neither body carries `Reviewed by:`; deploy-health green on #183, no run for #115's merge commit (it predates the workflow). Checked: unmarked `post.test.ts`, `PagePosts.test.tsx`; no `[guards F072.n]` marker exists anywhere (#599).

Overtaken by Don's ruling of 2026-10-02 on #318 ('There's no way to delete an announcement'): owners soft-delete their own posts with `group.post_delete` (#319) [V post.ts header]. The ruling is on #318, not yet a dated line in the scenario's Rulings, so `sync-roadmap` should amend F072; the newer ruling wins.

criteria.text: An announcement appears on its Page and in browse, reading as coming from the Page and not as a listing: no price, no buy control, no listing chrome
criteria.note: Posts render on the Page (`PagePosts.tsx`) and as post cards in browse (`browse_feed`, `BrowseResultCard.tsx`); no price field or buy control exists on a post [V]. Built by #115 and #258; no `Reviewed by:` on either; deploy-health: no run for #115, green on #258. Smoked: green smoke-live runs after the last merge opened `page` and `explore` (10-14 to 10-16), a load check only. Nothing asserts the absence of listing chrome (#601); unmarked tests (#599).

criteria.text: One whose start time has passed stops appearing in browse, with no manual cleanup
criteria.note: Change #814 (#815, merged 10-16) keeps a dated post in `browse_feed` and `announcements_withheld` until `coalesce(ends_at, starts_at)` has passed, so a post with an end time outlasts its start [V migration 20261016150052]. #814 is `Path: well-worn` with no scenario change and no PM ruling, so the scenario's 'start time has passed' and the shipped rule disagree; routed to `scope-scenario`. Built before that by #266/#258 behaviour; #815 is review-skipped.

criteria.text: One with no event date leaves browse after 14 days and moves to an Earlier section on its Page, unless its owner set a show-until date; it shows Posted <date>
criteria.note: Half built: Explore cards say 'Posted <date>' (`metro-time.ts`, #258). Missing: the 14-day cut (`browse_feed` lets `starts_at is null` through forever), the Earlier section, the show-until field (no `show_until` anywhere in `src` or migrations) and the Posted line on the Page [V grep]. Don's ruling 2026-10-02 (option A); open Issue #314.

criteria.text: The composer takes an optional date and time and an optional address of its own; a start is returned by a time-windowed read to the hour; an undated post is never returned by one; times are the metro's
criteria.note: `starts_at` and `location_id` are written by `group.post_create` (#183); `browse_feed` compares timestamptz bounds and requires `starts_at is not null` for a window; `METRO_TIME_ZONE` in `metro-time.ts` is the one zone, a constant until the metro carries its own (#173; `markets.timezone` now exists but nothing reads it) [V]. Built by #183, #212, #258 (no `Reviewed by:`); deploy-health green on all. Smoked: `explore` green after the last merge, a load check only. Checked: unmarked `metro-time.test.ts`, `post.test.ts`, `tests/announcement-card-db.test.ts` (#599).

criteria.text: One switch for who it reaches, defaulting to anyone; the words name the people, neither "announcement" nor "bulletin" is in any label; beside the restricted setting a live count that reads as words at zero
criteria.note: `AudienceSwitch.tsx`: 'Anyone' default, restricted setting shown but not postable (delivery is cut), count reads 'Nobody yet' at zero [V]. Built by #183 (no `Reviewed by:`, deploy-health green). One test reads one label (`PagePosts.test.tsx`); nothing scans every label and state (#601); unmarked (#599).

criteria.text: An announcement that fails to save leaves nothing behind: no half-made row on the Page, in browse or in its history
criteria.note: Series, place and post inserts, tags and the event run in one `withTransaction` in `group.post_create` [V post.ts]. Built by #183 (no `Reviewed by:`, deploy-health green). Checked: unmarked `PagePosts.test.tsx`, `tests/page-post-db.test.ts` (rollback) (#599).

criteria.text: An announcement or gathering may carry an optional end time; one with a time offers add-to-calendar; its image carries default alt text built from title, date and place; the label stays Event
criteria.note: Half built: `ends_at` with a check constraint (#263), `.ics` with `DTEND`, `AddToCalendarLink` on posts and gatherings (#261), and `cardImageAlt` on browse cards [V]. Missing: the photo on the Page's own post takes the first line of the post as alt (`PagePosts.tsx:525`), not title, date and place (#596). The label 'Event' is not asserted [A]. Unmarked tests (#599).
